selected_evidence.requirement: Secure source access and end-to-end synchronization health
selected_evidence.summary: Proves node2 can read node1 using its dedicated key and that source/target hashes remain identical.

Healthy baseline boot ID `35357529-a0fa-4786-9c4e-61d35ea15352`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `2a00971b-9610-448b-a8f6-1573c6f88611`, recovered SSH/source data, and successful downstream synchronization.

Healthy baseline boot ID `5716e7fd-e5d9-4334-a9c0-a2ba47dad387`, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID `fc02ea7a-7196-4138-8920-3faa0a71553d`, recovered `crond`, persisted target data and schedule, and live post-restart source/target parity.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

dst='/etc/inventory/app.conf'
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
scp -q -i /root/.ssh/inventory_sync -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$src" "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0640 "$tmp"
if [ -f "$dst" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$dst"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    logger -t inventory-config-sync 'app.conf already synchronized'
    exit 0
fi
mv -f "$tmp" "$dst"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
logger -t inventory-config-sync 'app.conf synchronized from node1'
